page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: heading "III." centred, then Latin verse with large initial J, signature line "SAMUEL HEMMANNUS, S.S. Th. St." Rule across. Below: heading "IV.", German verse with decorative initial E, a smaller italic-type dedication line, attribution line, and "FINIS" centred at the foot. No marginal notes, no running head, no page number visible.

main_text.head: III.
main_text.p:
JESU levamen cordium!
Quis te triumphus reddidit
Cœli beatæ Patriæ?
main_text.head: IV.
main_text.p:
E Sist ja nun alles im Boden erstorben/
Nichts grunet / als scheinet als wär es verdorben:
Wie kömts dann/mein Freunde/ daß du nun allein
Kanst grunen/ vnd führ'n so schön Früchte hinein?
Ich muß wohl gedencken/ dich habe befeuchtet
Der Regen deß / der nun im Himmel hoch leuchtet.

p.i: Zu bezeugung seiner unverfälschten freundschafft zugesetzt

page.notes: The initial letters J and E are decorative woodcut initials. The first verse block contains a dedication signature in small capitals. Some lines of the German verse are in black letter and are rendered here in roman type. The lower-left faint ghosted text is show-through from the reverse page and is omitted. The word "Kanst" and "grunen" in the German verse are printed as shown.
